name: overscroll-touch-wide
description: a wide touch screen (an iPad in landscape, a touch laptop - above the 899px phone breakpoint, coarse pointer) keeps the desktop layout's document scrolling but loses the browser's document gestures: html computes overscroll-behavior: none while html/body overflow stay visible, the desktop shell still fits the viewport, and the pane body still scrolls

mutation.declaration: styles/global.css: the document gesture lock's media query reverted to @media (max-width: 899px) alone (the (any-pointer: coarse) arm removed)
mutation.note: Fails: html computes overscroll-behavior: auto at 1280px with a coarse pointer, so a wide touch screen keeps pull-to-refresh and page bounce.
